text.p: Sabratek Corp said Friday it completed a secondary $18 per share offering that raised $19 million.
Of the 1,276,575 shares of common stock sold, 1.1 million shares were sold by the company and 176,574 shares by certain stockholders.
Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Salomon Brothers Inc, Smith Barney Inc and Jefferies & Co Inc are managers of the offering.
Upon completion of the offering, Sabratek will have about 9.6 million shares of common stock outstanding. The company also granted underwriters a 191,486 share overallotment option.

Sabratek develops, produces and markets advanced, intractive therapeutic and diagnostic medical systems designed to meet the needs of the alternative-site healthcare market. The company said it will use proceeds from the offering to expand its manufacturing capabilities, to fund product development and expand sales and marketing activities. A portion may go toward future joint ventures or acquisitions.
